title: Criminal and credit checks on all applicants
prompt: We want to run criminal and credit checks on every job applicant, including interns. Any POPIA issues?
must: Notes criminal behaviour information is special personal information (s26, s33)
Explains credit checks for employment are limited to positions requiring honesty with cash or finances (NCA regulations)
Recommends role-based justification, informing applicants and obtaining consent
Mentions s57(1)(b) prior authorisation for vendors processing criminal information on behalf of third parties
must_not: Says blanket checks for all roles are fine
